breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error verbatim: 'Assume the drag force is negligible compared to the weight of the raindrop.' The ground truth requires balancing weight minus buoyancy against aerodynamic drag with C_d = 0.5. The agent failed to recognize that neglecting drag makes terminal velocity undefined and did not introduce the necessary drag force balance equation.
